response.overview: Merret and Sophie are two young women sharing a Wg in Berlin. Between late-night conversations, everyday chaos, and the little dramas of living together, their shared apartment quickly becomes the setting for all kinds of funny and sometimes bizarre situations. With a playful sitcom-like tone, the film follows their friendship and everyday life, relationships, work, and each other. What starts as an ordinary day in their WG can easily turn into something completely unexpected.
response.title: Zwei
